# sonarqube_application_branch (Resource)

A branch of an application: a named combination of branches of the application's projects, e.g. a release. Requires Developer edition or above. Renaming changes it in place. Import ID: `application/branch`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Application branches require the Developer edition or higher. The project
# branches must exist (they are created by analysis).
resource "sonarqube_application_branch" "release" {
  application = sonarqube_application.shop.key
  name        = "release-2.4"
  projects = {
    (sonarqube_project.api.project) = "release/2.4"
    (sonarqube_project.web.project) = "" # main branch
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application` (String) Application key.
- `name` (String) Branch name. It cannot be the name of the application's main branch.
- `projects` (Map of String) Branch of each project to include, by project key: a branch name, or `""` for the project's main branch. The projects must belong to the application; projects of the application that are not listed are left out of this branch.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `application/branch`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sonarqube_application_branch.release 'example-shop/release-2.4'
```
